title: Reverse Vowels in a String
description: Given a string `s`, reverse only its vowels and leave every other character in its original position. Vowels are `a`, `e`, `i`, `o`, `u` in either case. Input: an ASCII string `s`. Output: the transformed string.
constraints: s contains only ASCII letters and spaces
hints: Keep track of the smallest state needed to continue matching or comparing characters.
Test empty, one-character, repeated-character, and boundary inputs.
